request: Update the reviewer so that it does NOT approve tasks easily. It must enforce strict production-quality standards. Require explicit checks for completeness, clarity, differentiation, and limitations. If anything is missing or weak, it must return 'revise' with specific instructions instead of approving.
title: Enhance reviewer to enforce strict quality standards
goals: Modify the reviewer's approval criteria to enforce strict production-quality standards
Implement explicit checks for task completeness, clarity, differentiation, and limitations
Ensure the reviewer returns 'revise' with specific instructions if standards are not met
constraints: Do not allow the reviewer to approve tasks that do not meet all specified criteria
Ensure the reviewer provides detailed feedback for revisions
success_criteria: Reviewer only approves tasks that meet all defined quality standards
Reviewer provides specific revision instructions if a task is incomplete or unclear
Reviewer checks for clear differentiation and limitations in tasks
